\section*{S1. Search protocol}

The inclusion criteria I1--I3 and exclusion codes E1--E7 (main text, Section~1) were fixed before the
search started. The search cutoff was 2026-11-08. S1 and S2 used title queries on official venue listings;
S3 used Crossref title queries, an arXiv abstract query, and snowballing from comparison tables. Abstracts
and full texts were read at screening where available. Table~\ref{tab:s-search} gives each search; the
per-record logs (every listing URL, every title hit with its decision and exclusion code, and the
full-text tables) accompany this supplement as \texttt{search/s1-cvf.md}, \texttt{search/s2-ml.md},
\texttt{search/s3-aaai-journals-arxiv-snowball.md}, \texttt{search/g-gap.md} and
\texttt{search/manual-pdfs.md}.

The three searches give 106 distinct included records after de-duplication (six were found twice). The second pass
added CTKD and the projector study (SRD); two coordinator rulings removed LTKD (E4: CIFAR-100-LT only) and
PE-BKD (analysis only).
% CRD pair list checked against the author repository benchmark tables, 2026-11-14:
% https://github.com/HobbitLong/RepDistiller#benchmark-results-on-cifar-100
Manual retrieval added six methods, for 112 included paper records. The standard CIFAR-100 CRD pairs used
for eligibility were ResNet-56$\to$ResNet-20, ResNet-110$\to$ResNet-20 or ResNet-32,
ResNet-32$\times$4$\to$ResNet-8$\times$4, WRN-40-2$\to$WRN-16-2 or WRN-40-1,
VGG-13$\to$VGG-8 or MobileNetV2, ResNet-32$\times$4$\to$ShuffleNetV1 or ShuffleNetV2,
ResNet-50$\to$MobileNetV2 or VGG-8, and WRN-40-2$\to$ShuffleNetV1. MobileNetV1 is the separate ImageNet pair. Two papers remain unassessable because no
full text was found. An independent spot-check drew 22 inclusions and 30 exclusions; among the 20 of each whose
full text was accessible it found no errors after adjudication (2 inclusions and 10 exclusions could not be
read).
